name: vibecore
description: An agent-first Angular starter kit for an educational companion portal: interactive demos, a glossary, a timeline and didactic article pages, plus the standards, safety model and skills an AI coding agent needs to work in the repo.

scripts.start: npm run prebuild && concurrently "npm run content:watch" "ng serve --port 2000"
scripts.start:codespaces: npm run prebuild && concurrently "npm run content:watch" "ng serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 2000"
scripts.build:prod: ng build --configuration production && npm run dist:prepare:prod && npm run build:verify && node scripts/check-test-baseline.mjs && node scripts/write-build-manifest.js && node scripts/verify-build.js
scripts.build:verify: node scripts/verify-harness.mjs --skip check-design-system.mjs,check-design-guides.mjs,check-guide-translations.mjs,check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-inline-templates.mjs && node scripts/check-site-config.mjs && node scripts/check-design-system.mjs && node scripts/check-design-guides.mjs && node scripts/check-guide-translations.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n-keys.mjs && node scripts/check-content-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-genericity.mjs && node scripts/check-storage-keys.mjs && node scripts/check-language-guide.mjs && node scripts/check-house-style.mjs && node scripts/verify-build.js --mid-chain
scripts.prebuild: npm run content:build && npm run i18n:build && npm run notifications:build && npm run fonts:licenses && npm run generate:build-version
scripts.prebuild:prod: npm run content:build:prod && node scripts/build-i18n-bundles.ts --prod && npm run notifications:build && npm run fonts:licenses && npm run generate:build-version && npm run generate:prerender-routes && npm run sitemap && npm run thumbs:validate
scripts.content:build: node scripts/sync-related-to-index.mjs && npm run validate:refs && node scripts/build-unified-content.ts && npm run glossary:build
scripts.content:build:prod: node scripts/sync-related-to-index.mjs && npm run validate:refs && node scripts/build-unified-content.ts --prod && npm run glossary:build
